Simplify modeling complexity with ['简化细碎叶片为大的羽状叶组']: use clean broad surfaces, shallow orderly folds, separated non-intersecting parts, and avoid tangled fabric or dense tiny wrinkles. Complete occluded, back, side and underside regions using {'type': 'axial', 'completionRule': '沿花架中心轴对称补充叶片'} and ['补充被遮挡的花盆完整轮廓']. Texture rule: 叶片有细密羽状纹理; 延续羽状叶片的重复排列纹理. Target plausible real-world dimensions are approximately 0.90 m wide, 0.80 m deep and 1.20 m high. Preserve the corresponding width-to-depth-to-height proportions. These are category-prior estimates rather than pixel measurements. Use conservative category structure, repeated modules, continuous closed geometry, and one 45-degree product view on a plain light background. Keep only the main object.
